description: Mint one free sg_live_ key so later score_spend and get_quota calls use 1,000 scores per UTC day instead of the anonymous 100. Call once per agent when you will score often and have no stored key. Do not call every turn, do not mint again if you already stored the secret, and do not call just to read remaining scores (use get_quota). Returns the secret once as api_key, plus key_id, key_prefix, label, tier free, daily_limit, created_at, and note. Only a hash is stored, so the secret cannot be shown again. Keys do not expire and there is no revoke tool; a lost key stays valid, and an unknown or non-sg_live_ value later returns invalid_api_key. At most 20 mints per client per UTC day, then key_mint_limit and no new key. Minting is free and does not consume a score. Send the secret later as Authorization: Bearer or as api_key. label is an optional stored name and does not set a cap, a scope, or an expiry.

label.description: Optional name stored with the key, up to 80 characters. Does not set a cap or an expiry. Keys do not expire.
